name: Tiny Waterloo
comment: Single source of truth for the map frame. Read by pipeline (Python), reference renderer (three.js) and the web viewer.

origin.comment: Local ENU origin (canvas 0,0 at z=0): centre of the UW main-campus landmark cluster (SLC, MC, EIT, E5/E7, Dana Porter) so the first 2x2 tile patch frames it.

projection.comment: Local tangent plane: transverse Mercator (UTM-like) centred on origin, metres. x=east, y=north, z=up (z relative to datum_m above sea level).

camera.comment: Fixed orthographic oblique camera. heading_deg = compass bearing the camera looks toward (horizontal), pitch_deg = downward tilt. Axes are derived and stored explicitly by pipeline/world.py; never re-derive from angles elsewhere.

sun.comment: Direction TOWARD the sun. Late-summer mid-afternoon in Waterloo, from the south-west so shadows fall north-east (up-right on screen).

heights.comment: Lossless PNG. encoded = 256*R + G ; height_m = encoded / units_per_m + floor_m ; valid = B > 127. height is z (metres relative to datum_m).

publish.comment: reference_tiles false: only tiles with accepted art are published, so the map shows the illustrated area and nothing else. data_cache/jobs can hold reference renders of unpainted tiles (context rings, earlier city-wide prep); with true every one of them would ship as a procedural tile.

art_harmonize.comment: Publish-time evening-out of neighbouring accepted tiles (pipeline/harmonize_art.py): detail-gain matching, cross-fade into the neighbour's own painting of each border band, colour levelling where no agreeing painting exists. art/accepted is never changed. locked_regions: regions of config/regions.json whose tiles are finished, as ordered lock groups (oldest first): a list of names is one group, a list of lists is several. The first group is harmonised among itself only; each later group is fitted to the groups before it and never sees a later group or an unlocked tile; unlocked tiles come last. So adding tiles never changes a locked tile. Once a new set of tiles is reviewed and final, add its region as a new last group, e.g. [["campus2x2", "park_uptown", "stage2_surround"], ["stage3_ring"]]: its tiles keep the art they were reviewed with. Adding it to an existing group instead re-harmonises that whole group as equals.

art_finish.comment: Deterministic pixel-art finish applied at publish time to accepted generated art (art/accepted keeps the original). Box-downscale to work_px, light unsharp mask, median-cut palette of `colors` without dithering, nearest-neighbour upscale to frame_px. One shared palette (art/palette_<id>.png, built from the palette_from style-sample tile) is used for every tile so colours match across seams.
